channel.title: Economy
channel.description: Find the latest economic news, current events and headlines, as well as blogs and video from CNBC.com.

item.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
item.description: Initial filings for unemployment insurance slipped to a seasonally adjusted 194,000.

item.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
item.description: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

item.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
item.description: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.

item.title: Car buyers are demanding lower prices and better tech. Automakers must deliver both
item.description: Bain says tech leads purchase considerations in China while price remains No. 1 in the U.S. and Europe, as pressure mounts on Western carmakers.

item.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
item.description: Housing data deteriorated further in September, according to separate reports Tuesday.

item.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
item.description: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

item.title: India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit
item.description: Sitharaman identified fuel, fertilizer and access to capital as risks for India’s economy in 2027.

item.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
item.description: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

item.title: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
item.description: Investors expect the Fed to pause rate hikes in October, but Kevin Warsh's rejection of traditional communications practices and continued concern about inflation leave the decision uncertain.

item.title: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done
item.description: 'We see real risks the Fed will deliver another rate hike in two weeks' time,' one Fedwatcher warns

item.title: U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting
item.description: The exchange comes as U.S. debt exceeds $40 trillion and 10-year Treasury yields remain above 5%, intensifying scrutiny of the fiscal outlook.

item.title: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
item.description: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

item.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
item.description: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

item.title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration
item.description: European trade commissioner Maroš Sefčovič met with Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing last week.
